paragraphs: The XJ 3.0d was introduced in the X351 generation, produced from 2009 to 2019. It uses the AJD-V6 - a 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, Ford-sourced with twin-turbocharging. The XJ 3.0d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0L V6 Diesel engine fitted to the XJ 3.0d - X351 (2009-2019).
